reference.name: Changing Workflow Runs grouping silently restores saved filters over pending edits
reference.summary: Choosing Group by in a saved Workflow Runs view replaces its active unsaved filters with saved filters, silently changing which runs are shown.
reference.expected: Changing grouping in the same view should retain its valid active filters and pending changes, or warn before discarding them.
reference.actual: Removing a saved Failed status chip shows three mixed-status runs and Reset/Update view. Selecting Workflow run status grouping restores the Failed chip, hides pending-change controls and leaves only the failed run. Unsaved added filters are also discarded. Saving the filter edit before grouping preserves results.
reproSteps: Create harmless workflow runs with Failed, Completed and Stopped statuses and a disposable Workflow Runs Table view.
Save a Name filter isolating those runs together with Workflow run status = Failed.
Remove only the Failed chip without saving. Confirm all three runs and Reset/Update view are visible.
Choose Options > Group > Workflow run status. Observe the Failed filter return, the count drop to one and pending-change controls disappear.
Compare saving the filter removal before grouping, and opening/dismissing Options without selecting grouping; these preserve the intended mixed-status results.
